integrity_note: The determinant census is exact and independently recomputable from finite integer arithmetic; diagonal-to-general extension and sharpness use an analytic symmetry and degree argument. External independent scientific validation has not been performed.
limitations: The theorem treats independent-coordinate product-Bernoulli weights in the four-cube only. It does not establish the conjectured inequality for all sixteen unrestricted vertex weights.
title: Exact Bernoulli product-weight profile for the four-cube simplex polynomial
